title: Purposes of processing (standards/privacy/purposes.yaml)
description: Why instructor data is processed, in plain language, with the workflows that serve each purpose, the data categories each uses (ids from setup.data_categories) and the legal basis proposed per jurisdiction. Proposals are for legal to confirm when it verifies a profile; they decide nothing themselves.

review_notes.description: Every judgement call, for legal and the head of training to settle

description.description: Plain language, as the notice will say it

workflows.description: Workflows that exist now; validate checks each is defined

planned_workflows.description: Workflows not built yet that will serve the purpose; validate does not require them to exist

reason.description: Why this basis, for legal and the head of training. Never printed in the notice

notice_text.description: What the instructor is told about this purpose's basis, in plain language. The notice prints this field and never `reason`; wording that states what the law requires carries "(legal review)"

basis.description: GDPR Article 6(1) bases, plus disclosed-purpose: a CCPA business or commercial purpose disclosed at collection, used only by overlay profiles (validate refuses it in a base profile). Identical in jurisdiction, purposes and retention (a test pins the equality)
